summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) on July 15, 2026, announcing a US$25 million strategic investment package with Quilla Resources Inc. and its subsidiary to expand its royalty exposure to the Chapi Copper Project. The transaction includes acquisition of equity in Quilla and an additional perpetual, uncapped 1.0% NSR royalty over specific concessions, increasing total royalty to 3.0% NSR. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation was stated. This is a routine investment and royalty acquisition, not a special situation such as a merger or tender offer.
